card.name: Digit after 10.10 in DOI numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit written right after '10.10' in a DOI citation, such as the 0, 3, 2 or 7 in 'doi:10.10x/...'. Also the 0 in '100' after '10' in numbers like U-100 or 10-100.

modes.label: DOI prefix digit
modes.description: The digit completing the 10.10x publisher code at the start of a DOI in a reference list.
modes.example: January 1998). "The culture of poverty". Society 35 (2): 7. doi:10.10<<0>>7/BF0283

modes.label: Zero in 100
modes.description: The 0 completing 100 after a leading 10 in names, ranges or counts.

card.plain: It fires on the digit that follows 10.10 in a journal citation's DOI code, and sometimes on the last zero of 100.
